name: Korean Protein Puffs
ingredients_raw: Protein Puff Blend 74% (Rice, Corn, Soy Protein Isolate, Chickpeas, Lentil, Sorghum), Korean Style Seasoning 9% (Iodised Salt, Dehydrated Garlic Powder, Sugar, Spices & Condiments (Chilli, Ginger), Dehydrated Onion Powder, Maltodextrin, Vinegar Powder, Fermented Soya Sauce Powder, Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein, Acidity Regulators (INS 330, INS 296), Yeast Extract), Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran Oil / Cottonseed Oil).
